Questions

Common questions.

Can one system cover several warehouses and branches?

Yes. Each warehouse and branch keeps its own stock and team, and management sees one combined view.

Do you integrate with M-Pesa and our accounting software?

Yes. M-Pesa, bank and card payments are matched automatically, and the system connects to your existing accounting or ERP.

How long before forecasts are useful?

With 12 months or more of sales and stock history, the first forecasts are usually live within weeks of starting.
